metadata.datasource: FUJIFILM Professional Data Guide AF3-207U (2005), printed p. 84 (PDF p. 42): vector paths of the spectral sensitivity and the D-76 small-tank characteristic curves; development table p. 76 (D-76, 20 C, EI 1600: 7 1/2 min).

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 391-652 nm: the "Spectrogram to Daylight (5400K)" ("Relative Sensitivity (log)", one decade per grid interval) with a 5400 K black body divided out (ASSUMED source spectrum, as Acros II); ASSUMED held below 391 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0382 dex/nm above 652 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -1.44..2.41 (D-76 small tank, 20 C, 7 1/2 min at EI 1600 (the sheet's own time; G-bar 0.61): 7.5 min, interpolated between the plotted 6 and 7.5 min curves; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.825); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.316 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral silver, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0106 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
